predictions.rationale: Implements the "Agency" that manages and schedules critic agents, running them in background threads and coordinating their analysis of the design – core to continuous design critique.
Abstract superclass that defines behaviour and lifecycle of individual Critic agents, directly embodying the Design Critics concept.
Application-level bootstrap that starts the critic subsystem/background thread when ArgoUML launches.
Provides the standard Control Mechanism coordinating when and how critics are fired, crucial for continuous analysis.
Defines the interface/abstract logic for control mechanisms that invoke critics, underpinning their execution strategy.
Represents individual suggestions or issues raised by critics; central data object for conveying improvements to users.
Manages the collection of ToDoItem objects produced by critics, enabling tracking and display of design suggestions.
User-interface tab that presents the list of critic suggestions to the designer, directly supporting the feature’s feedback mechanism.
UI action allowing users to enable/disable automatic background critique; directly linked to continuous execution of critics.
Initialises and registers the full set of UML-specific critic agents with the Agency, ensuring their availability during design.
